revision_reason: The v1 cells produced zero samples because their instructions were absent from the frozen offline T5 cache. V2 changes only task membership before any candidate outcome was observed, using cached development tasks with new states.
purpose: Expand D21 development supervision with preregistered new states that may contain mixed-quality candidates; do not use frozen task50 evaluation cells or future confirmation tasks.
rules: All task-state cells, K values, intervention and eligibility thresholds are frozen before rollout outcomes are observed.
Clean K=4 competence is the only eligibility criterion for object-shift K=8 collection.
Every eligible stress cell is retained, including 0/8 and 8/8 outcomes; stress outcomes cannot change membership.
The frozen task50 states32-39 evaluation cells are excluded from fitting and calibration.
Future independent confirmation tasks are not included in this development pool.
Candidate success labels train only the external utility ranker; hard safety gates stay frozen.
No D18 attribution threshold, belief threshold or hard-gate rule may be changed from these outcomes.
